narrative.intro: American Centrifuge Operating shows a concentrated federal presence in FY2026 to date. The Department of Defense and other agencies obligated $916M in contract funds to American Centrifuge Operating through 2 awards, with an average award size of $458M. Obligations are up 361.8% year over year compared with the prior fiscal period reported. Fiscal-year history shows a steady increase in obligations from $38.9M in FY21, $42.9M in FY22, $50M in FY23, $85M in FY24, $198M in FY25, and $916M in FY26. Industry exposure is heavily weighted toward a single NAICS: Other Basic Inorganic Chemical Manufacturing received $900M in FY2026 to date, while Nuclear Electric Power Generation received $15.9M. Award count and average award size indicate that a small number of large awards account for most of the FY2026 obligations. Contract totals for the current year are partial and represent fiscal year to date activity.
